name: comp-465
title: Pagination With Counter
blurb: Numbered pagination with jump-to-page input field.
description: Pagination control with clickable page numbers, ellipsis for skipped ranges, and a text input to jump directly to a page.
use_when: You need to navigate large lists and let users jump to specific pages.
avoid_when: Infinite scroll or cursor-based pagination is more practical for real-time data.
a11y: Previous/next buttons are disabled at bounds with aria-disabled. Page links are keyboard-navigable.
